Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The cross-asset regime is risk-on, but conviction is only marginally above neutral and composites are weak. BTC is the most credible signal, while ETH and SOL carry negative alpha, higher beta/volatility, and weaker liquidity. LTC is explicitly flat with materially negative alpha and poor liquidity. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile: identical default-looking signals with zero volatility, expected shortfall, liquidity, and institutional-factor data. Maintain reduced aggregate risk and avoid treating those generic long signals as validated conviction.
